name: Sound system
description: A wall of stacked loudspeaker cabinets in the light of two coloured lamps: four big bass bins at the bottom, six cabinets of two cones each above them, eight horns along the top. Each cone is a part of the spectrum, the low notes on the left of its row, and pumps with it: the cone and its dust cap come forward and the roll of rubber round them leans. Every cabinet has a small ladder of lamps that shows its part of the sound.
